border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas, #ffffff); color: var(--secondary-ink, #555d6b); box-shadow: var(--sheet-shadow, 0 18px 54px #20253a16); font: 400 13px/1.6 var(--font-ui, "Facetmark Inter", "Facetmark CJK", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif); } .ds-chapter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; } .ds-chapter-select { max-width: 190px; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #232631); font: 600 15px/1.6 var(--font-ui, "Facetmark Inter", "Facetmark CJK", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chapter-select:hover { background: var(--soft, #efedff); } .ds-chapter-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5c4ddb); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-percent { color: var(--accent, #5c4ddb); font-weight: 700; min-width: 4ch; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-reading-top { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--soft, #efedff); color: var(--accent, #5c4ddb); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, scale 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-reading-top:hover { background: var(--selected, #e9e5ff); } .ds-progress-track { position: absolute; left: 24px; right: 24px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--soft, #efedff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-value { display: block; width: 42%; height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #5c4ddb); } @supports (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) { .ds-reading { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #ffffff) 82%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rule, #e7e9ef) 72%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3); } } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) { .ds-reading { background: var(--canvas, #ffffff); backdrop-filter: none; } } .ds-reading-top:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5c4ddb); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reading-top:active:not(:disabled) { scale: .96; } .ds-reading-top:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reading-top { transition: none; } .ds-reading-top:active { scale: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Facetmark combines application navigation and searchable categories in one sidebar, leaving a spacious content canvas for the collection. Neutral white and softly shaded surfaces carry readable text; indigo identifies actions, focus and selection. Complete capsule controls, circular icon actions and rounded content surfaces make the interface tactile without tinting the entire workspace.

This direction follows the user's second 2026-10-19 rejection. The lavender/10px replacement at `082e36d` is superseded. HeroUI now leads real control construction, GSAP composes page and section transitions, and Motion retains shared selection, card reflow and overlay presence. GithubStarsManager informs collection organization; FlClash informs selection continuity. These are references, not approved mockups.
keyCharacteristics: One sidebar for navigation, searchable categories and supporting utilities.
Neutral content surfaces with focused indigo action and selection states.
Bundled Inter and Noto Sans SC with a readable 28/18/16/15/13 type hierarchy.
Full capsule controls, circular icon buttons and proportional rounded panels.
HeroUI control states and interruptible, layered GSAP content transitions.
Immediate state and focus, native semantics and live reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Local Accent Rule.
rules.body: Keep the workspace neutral. Apply indigo to a meaningful action, focus or selected state; do not restore the rejected blanket lavender wash.

rules.name: The Shared Reading Scale Rule.
rules.body: Preserve the same title and summary hierarchy when changing card/list layout. Metadata supports the description; it never takes its place or justifies reducing the readable content scale.

rules.name: The Immediate State Rule.
rules.body: State, data and focus never wait for an animation. One engine owns each animated property on an element. Closing overlays become inert and noninteractive while their visual exit finishes.

dos: Do keep application navigation and searchable categories in one sidebar.
Do use complete capsules for controls and circles for icon-only actions.
Do preserve the bundled fonts and shared 28/18/16/15/13 content hierarchy.
Do retain native links, button/form semantics and explicit selection states.
Do keep search drafts, Agent drafts, task snapshots and processing consent intact.
Do give each animated property one owner and clean up interrupted timelines.
Do verify rapid switching, keyboard activation and live reduced motion.
Do inspect fresh Web and installed Windows captures and continuous interactions.
donts: Don't restore the rejected lavender wash, 10px controls or split rail/category layout.
Don't reduce readable metadata to 10–11px or make summaries visually secondary to it.
Don't let a control library change native click, keyboard or form behavior unnoticed.
Don't make data or focus wait for decorative motion.
Don't infer account access, saved configuration or completed work from discovery alone.
Don't reuse historical green runs, specimens or reviewer verdicts as current visual approval.
